entries.summary: On Windows, run @byok-sdk/client and @byok-sdk/keys at the same version. The keys launcher no longer starts PowerShell or reads the Pi projection directory's owner. It requires the OWNER RIGHTS (S-1-3-4) READ_CONTROL ACE that the client now grants when it creates the directory (#1373). When the versions differ, the launch fails closed. A 0.37.0 launcher refuses a directory made by an older client with pi_projection_acl_owner_rights_missing. An older launcher refuses a directory made by a 0.37.0 client with pi_projection_acl_unauthorized_ace. The projection directory is created fresh on every launch, so there is nothing to migrate.
